title: Bilinear matrix-multiplication tensor decomposition
description: An explicit rank-r bilinear algorithm for the matrix product of an m x k matrix by a k x n matrix, given as the three coefficient matrices u, v, w. This is a first attempt at the tensor-decomposition schema that is still missing alongside the format-rank table schema of fmm_digest; it is offered for discussion and is expected to change.

dimensions.description: The ORDERED triple [m, k, n]: A is m x k, B is k x n, C = A B is m x n. Ordered, unlike the unordered format triple of the format-rank table, because u, v and w are written against a particular orientation.

rank.description: Number r of bilinear products, equal to the number of rows of u, v and w. An upper bound on the tensor rank of the format, not a claim of minimality.

scale.description: Positive integer s such that s * C_flat = w^T p. A decomposition over the integers with no common denominator has s = 1.

layout.description: Flattening order used for the column indices of u, v and w. 'row-major' means A is indexed by i*k + j, B by j*n + l and C by i*n + l.

ring.description: Ring the coefficients are taken from. Omitted means the integers.

u.description: Left factor, r rows of length m*k, in the sparse row form below.

v.description: Right factor, r rows of length k*n.

w.description: Output factor, r rows of length m*n.

provenance.description: Where the decomposition comes from, so that credit for component schemes is not lost when a decomposition is composed from published ones.

method.description: How the decomposition was obtained, in prose.

components.description: Published schemes the decomposition is built from.

multiplicity.description: How many times this component is used.

operations.description: Operations applied to the components, named so that a reader can reconstruct the count.

count.description: The rank written out as the arithmetic of the component ranks, for example '2829 = 123 + 11*150 + 4*264'.

contributor.description: The contributor's ORCID iD, in full URI or hyphenated form.

verification.description: What was checked, and how, so that a reader can tell a fully verified entry from a reported one.

exactTensorIdentity.description: True only if EVERY coefficient of the matrix-multiplication tensor was checked exactly, including the zero coefficients.

tensorCoefficientsChecked.description: Should equal (m*k) * (k*n) * (m*n) when exactTensorIdentity is true.

distinctProducts.description: True if no row of u, v, w is zero and no pair (u_t, v_t) repeats, so the r products are genuinely distinct.

arithmetic.description: Arithmetic the checks were carried out in. Floating point does not certify an exact identity.

checker.description: Pointer to the script that reproduces the checks.

sparseMatrix.description: A matrix as an array of r rows. A row is an array of [columnIndex, value] pairs with zero-based column indices; any index not listed is zero. Indices within a row should be distinct and ascending.
